Because mobile
observability shouldn't suck

New Observability

Observability that's
custom-built for mobile

The way we build and deploy software has changed radically in the past decade, but most observability is still stuck in a traditional model that severely limits how developers debug and monitor their apps. BITDRIFT
DRAG TO COMPARE
TRADITIONAL
01

Doesn't impose cost constraints

Only pay for what's useful. bitdrift stores and analyzes just the data you need and not everything you collect.

02

Lets you log everything

No limits. Log everything from device events to network context if it might help one day, capture it now.

03

Builds intelligence into devices

Devices decide what to log and store in real time powered by a local Ring Buffer and smart logic at the edge.

04

Has instant feedback cycles

05

Gives mobile the focus it deserves

Mobile devs and their agents finally get first-class observability on par with backend tools, built for app fleets.

01

Expensive & inefficient

02

Forces teams to log less

High costs make teams log only what's essential, leading to gaps in context when things break.

03

Assumes dumb devices

Old Observability treats devices as passive log shippers with no logic beyond basic filters or hardcoded telemetry.

04

Has slow feedback cycles

05

Ignores mobile

Old Observability leaves mobile behind. Devs rely on patchwork tools and only hear about bugs when users report them.

Log everything, but only
send what you really need

Install the bitdrift SDK
